3da1bf7625126e22.description: Job Title: Chief Specialist Acceleration Asset Ramp-up Reporting To: Director, Technology Development Business Unit / Function: Technology & Innovation Department: Technology Enablement Grade: M13 Why This Role Matters The Chief Specialist Acceleration Asset Ramp-up exists to help Ma aden bring mining and processing assets to stable, productive operation faster. The role creates value by identifying the highest-impact opportunities across throughput, recovery, uptime, cost and production readiness, then translating them into practical interventions that accelerate performance improvement. It provides an enterprise perspective across assets, enabling successful approaches to be reused rather than solved independently at each operation. Working across Operations, Technology & Innovation, Data & AI and project stakeholders, the role strengthens the transition from commissioning to reliable operations and embeds repeatable approaches that improve the performance of future asset ramp-ups. What You Will Deliver Asset Ramp-up & Performance Shape and embed an enterprise approach to asset ramp-up that shortens the path from commissioning to stable operations across mining and processing assets. Diagnose systemic ramp-up constraints and enable focused interventions that address root causes and protect production value. Value Realization Translate ramp-up opportunities into measurable value hypotheses, performance targets and interventions with clear ownership and benefit tracking. Drive sustained improvements in ramp-up speed, asset utilization and operational readiness through fact-based performance management. Provide actionable insights that enable leadership to prioritize interventions and investments against the areas of greatest operational value. Digital & Analytics Enablement Accelerate the application of advanced analytics, digital twins and predictive capabilities where they improve commissioning, stabilization and ramp-up decisions. Embed relevant digital capabilities into operational workflows to strengthen real-time visibility, decision quality and performance management. Enable repeatable ramp-up use cases to scale across assets in partnership with technology, data and solution teams. Enterprise Execution & Governance Orchestrate alignment across Operations, Technology & Innovation, Data & AI, projects and commissioning stakeholders to resolve cross-functional dependencies and barriers. Establish consistent governance, performance measures and executive-level visibility across priority ramp-up initiatives. Standards & Organizational Capability Develop and embed scalable ramp-up playbooks, tools and practices appropriate to different asset classes and operating environments. Convert lessons from asset ramp-ups into reusable organizational knowledge that improves subsequent commissioning and stabilization. Build organizational capability through technical coaching, knowledge transfer and adoption of proven ramp-up practices. What Success Looks Like Reduced time from commissioning to stable and targeted operating performance. Improved throughput, recovery, uptime and asset utilization during ramp-up. Measurable value realized from prioritized digital, analytics and operational interventions. Increased adoption of standardized ramp-up methods, playbooks and proven use cases across applicable assets. Stronger visibility of ramp-up performance, risks and value realization to enable faster management decisions. Desired Candidate Profile Bachelor s degree in Engineering, Mining, Metallurgy, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline. Master s degree in a relevant discipline is advantageous. 12 15+ years of relevant experience in mining, mineral processing or comparable heavy industry environments. Significant exposure to asset commissioning, operational ramp-up, stabilization and performance improvement. Experience delivering operational value through digital, analytics or technology-enabled improvement initiatives. Experience working across multidisciplinary operational, technical, project and technology stakeholders. Asset ramp-up and commissioning optimization Mining and processing operational excellence Production performance and bottleneck analysis Advanced analytics and digital enablement Value realization and benefits management Performance management and KPI design Strategic problem-solving Cross-functional execution Senior stakeholder influencing Change and capability building

3d2734ad33aa1217.description: Job description About Noon Noon is a Saudi EdTech company. Noon Track runs inside schools: a hybrid programme that prepares students for Qudrat ( قدرات ) and Tahsili ( تحصيلي ), the national university-admission exams. Our students are 15 to 17 years old. Noon is becoming an AI-native company, department by department, and the number of schools we serve is growing. We believe every student deserves world-class teachers. And to make it happen, we’re reimagining everything about education: from cutting-edge tech to peer learning and physical spaces that spark curiosity. Hear about our vision directly from our CEO here. Learn more about us [ here] The role You will be the one designer who owns the student experience. Primarily that means the student app: where students study, work with an AI tutor, answer questions, and take part in activities, including games and head-to-head duels on a topic. You will also shape parts of the live classroom experience. This is a Senior/Principal-level individual contributor Product Designer role. There is no design team underneath you and no manager drawing your roadmap. You take a problem from the first student conversation to the shipped screen, and you decide what to look at next. Why this role One owner of the whole student experience, with a direct line to leadership. Speed: with AI in the workflow, ideas go from research to release in days, not quarters. An experimentation practice being built from the ground up, with you shaping it. A company expanding into more schools, with a long-term ambition to match. What you will do Spend real time with students in Saudi schools. Interviews, focus groups, classroom observation. Turn what you hear into design decisions, and go back to check them. Design for Saudi Arabia, not for the generic 'best practice' app. Patterns that work in London or San Francisco often fail here. You know why, and you can show it in your work. Own the student app end to end. Flows, information architecture, prototypes, final UI, and the handover to engineering. Design activities students want to come back to, games and duels included, with learning as the gate: an activity that is more fun but teaches less is a regression. Run experiments. State a hypothesis, build the variants, agree the metric, and read the result honestly. You will help build the experimentation practice, not just use it. Work AI-native. Use AI tools for generation, prototyping and production so your time goes to research and judgement. We care about the quality of your decisions, not how many pixels you pushed by hand. Work directly with the product manager and engineers. Short loops, fast releases, no layers. About you (To be successful in this role, you should have): Roughly 5 years of experience in UX, product design experience. We care less about the number and more about how many people you have interviewed and what you did with it. A research practice you can describe in detail: how you recruit, what you ask, how you synthesise, how it reached the product. A portfolio of projects that demonstrate your creativity and delivery of results through great consumer-facing mobile-first experiences Proficiency in using various tools and techniques to create and communicate your design ideas, such as sketches, wireframes, mockups, prototypes, etc. Experience in conducting user research and testing in different contexts and cultures, using both qualitative and quantitative methods A strong sense of empathy, curiosity, and creativity, and a willingness to learn and experiment Why Noon? Real impact — your work directly affects how thousands of students learn every day. Speed and autonomy — small team, big problems, zero bureaucracy. AI-native culture — we don't just talk about AI, we build with it daily. Well-funded — Series B closed, substantial recurring revenue, and accelerating. Mission that matters — every student deserves world-class teachers. We're making it happen. Benefits In addition to a competitive base salary, we offer: Performance-based bonus 21 days of annual leave Full premium Medical coverage, including Family Dependent Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

3d6d959d765bc754.description: Job Description The Registrar Nephrology is a physician in specialty training who delivers comprehensive nephrology care exclusively through virtual platforms. The role focuses on the assessment, diagnosis, and management of acute and chronic kidney diseases using telehealth technologies, ensuring safe, evidence-based, and patient-centred care under consultant supervision, while supporting continuity of care and chronic disease management Virtual Patient Consultations and clinical Management:  Conduct video and phone consultations for patients with nephrology-related conditions.  Assess and manage chronic kidney disease (CKD), hypertension, electrolyte disorders, proteinuria, haematuria, nephrolithiasis, and post-AKI follow-up.  Review laboratory results and imaging remotely and adjust management plans accordingly.  Identify red flags requiring urgent in-person assessment or hospital referral.  Develop individualized treatment and monitoring plans in collaboration with consultants.  Ensure accurate and timely documentation in the electronic medical record (EMR).  Arrange virtual follow-ups and coordinate care with primary providers. Chronic Disease Management and Continuity of Care:  Monitor CKD progression using laboratory trends and patient-reported outcomes.  Provide virtual counselling on lifestyle modification, diet, fluid balance, and medication adherence.  Support anaemia of CKD, CKD-MBD, and blood pressure management remotely.  Collaborate with dietitians and allied health professionals via telehealth platforms.  Coordinate dialysis preparation education and timely referrals when indicated. Quality Assurance, Patient Safety, and Compliance:  Adhere to nephrology clinical guidelines, telemedicine regulations, and ethical standards.  Ensure safe prescribing practices, including dose adjustments in renal impairment.  Monitor and counsel patients regarding medication side effects and warning signs.  Report patient safety concerns and adverse events to the Quality Department.  Participate in virtual audits, quality improvement initiatives, and clinical reviews. Telehealth Platform Proficiency and Digital Care Delivery:  Utilize telemedicine platforms for video consultations, secure messaging, and lab result reviews.  Maintain accurate, complete, and confidential digital patient records.  Optimize use of remote monitoring data (e.g. home blood pressure readings).  Participate in telehealth training and collaborate with IT support for system optimization Patient Experience and Satisfaction:  Communicate diagnoses and management plans clearly and empathetically.  Provide education on kidney disease progression, treatment options, and red-flag symptoms.  Address patient concerns and follow-up questions promptly via telehealth channels.  Encourage adherence to treatment plans and follow-up schedules Multidisciplinary and Consultant Collaboration:  Collaborate virtually with nephrology consultants for case discussions and escalation of care.  Coordinate care with primary care physicians, nurses, pharmacists, and dietitians.  Participate in multidisciplinary virtual meetings and care planning. Professional Development and Teaching:  Maintain up-to-date knowledge in nephrology.  Attend CME, workshops and conferences.  Participate in case discussion and academic activity.  Support teaching and supervision of junior doctors when required. Skills Medical degree (MBBS or equivalent) from an accredited institution. Completion of Internal Medicine residency from an accredited program. Nephrology training/fellowship (in progress or completed). Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS) classification and registration as Registrar Nephrology. Strong clinical judgment with expertise in CKD and renal pharmacology. Experience or strong interest in telemedicine-based care. Proficiency in EMR systems and telehealth platforms. Excellent communication, analytical, and organizational skills. Commitment to patient safety, quality improvement, and continuous professional development. Education Medicine & Surgery

3d4591d0057d20ba.description: Job Overview: The E-commerce Operations Senior Specialist is responsible for the end-to-end daily operation of Al Ahli’s online store on Salla. Responsibilities: Order & Fulfilment Management Monitor incoming Salla orders daily and track order status from placement through dispatch and delivery. Identify and act on delayed, stuck, cancelled, or failed orders, including payment and address issues. Coordinate with the warehouse on daily picking, packing, and dispatching to ensure orders are fulfilled accurately and on time. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to coordinate across IT, warehouse, and marketing teams. Ability to work cross‑functionally and manage multiple priorities. Highly organized, detail‑oriented, and comfortable in a fast‑paced environment. Languages: Fluent Arabic and English, with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

المعلومات المطلوبة. تقديم الدعم الفني للعملاء فيما يتعلق باختيار المحركات الكهربائية وتطبيقاتها واستبدال المحركات القائمة. متابعة حالة عروض الأسعار والطلبات والفرص البيعية وتحديث سجلات العملاء والمشاريع. المساعدة في إعداد العروض التقديمية والبيانات الفنية والكتالوجات والمستندات الخاصة بالمنتجات. المشاركة في الاجتماعات الفنية والتجارية مع العملاء والمقاولين والاستشاريين. البحث عن فرص مبيعات جديدة وتطوير قاعدة العملاء في القطاعات الصناعية مثل النفط والغاز والبتروكيماويات والمياه والطاقة. متابعة المنافسين والأسعار واحتياجات السوق ورفع الملاحظات لفريق المبيعات. التنسيق مع فرق الشحن والمشتريات والخدمات الفنية لمتابعة الطلبات حتى مرحلة التوريد. الالتزام بإجراءات السلامة ومتطلبات العمل في المواقع الصناعية والعملاء. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. فهم جيد للمعدات الكهربائية، خاصة المحركات الكهربائية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتفاعل مع العملاء والفرق الداخلية. القدرة على جمع وتحليل البيانات الفنية. القدرة على العمل الميداني وزيارة المواقع. مهارات تنظيمية ومتابعة جيدة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل تتطلب العمل في المنطقة الشرقية، مدينة الخبر. يتضمن العمل زيارات ميدانية لمواقع العملاء الصناعية، مما يستدعي الالتزام بإجراءات السلامة ومتطلبات العمل في هذه البيئات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

3d23f3c8404c44ac.description: About the Role Airbus ** is seeking an H125 B1 Mechanical Training Instructor to join their team in Taif. This full-time position requires 0-1 years of experience and involves developing and delivering mechanical training courses for technicians, ensuring compliance with aviation and company regulations. Key Responsibilities Study and analyze customer training regulations. Develop Course Training Standards, Course Instructional Plans, and Course Synopses in accordance with customer regulations. Develop basic and advanced specialty courses as per customer regulations. Edit and update the Master Training Plan. Perform On-the-Job Training (OJT) for customer technicians using developed training aids. Operational Duties Comply with all Aviation, Safety, Quality, and Export Control Regulations and Procedures. Adhere to all Airbus Helicopters Management Systems, Policies, and Regulations. Inspect tools and Ground Support Equipment (GSE) for condition and expiration dates before any training activity, ensuring correct use. Verify components and parts for conditions (damages, leaks) and ensure documentation applicability before training. Determine and perform maintenance requirements for parts, clearances, tolerances, fuel and hydraulic leaks, and corrosion damage. Interpret wiring diagrams and technical publications. Ensure all work is recorded on appropriate paperwork and signed off progressively as required by the AHA Management System. Ensure correct use and control of aircraft parts and materials. Verify aircraft status regarding scheduled tasks and deferred items, ensuring serviceability and compliance with the applicable AHA Management System for Release to Service. Ensure timely completion of work and adherence to AHA Management System quality requirements. Evaluate the performance of assigned customer trainees. Conduct on-the-job training activities. Train personnel on the use of maintenance manuals, safety directives, and FOD procedures. Perform other assigned duties. Compliance and Integrity This role requires an awareness of potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, which is fundamental to the company's success, reputation, and sustainable growth. Airbus Helicopters Arabia for Aircraft Maintenance is dedicated to achieving workforce diversity and fostering an inclusive working environment. Work Environment Airbus supports flexible working arrangements where possible to stimulate innovative thinking and facilitate easier work, connection, and collaboration.

3d6a9ae1a0257285.description: About SAICO Insurance SAICO Insurance is seeking a Medical Claims Review Officer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 0-1 years of experience, focusing on the accurate evaluation and processing of medical claims. Role Overview The Medical Claims Review Officer is responsible for ensuring the clinical accuracy and compliance of medical claims with established policy guidelines and regulatory standards. This role involves detailed review of medical documentation and direct communication with healthcare providers to facilitate efficient claims management. Key Responsibilities Evaluate and verify medical claims to ensure clinical accuracy and compliance with policy guidelines and regulatory standards. Review patient records, medical reports, and supporting documentation to facilitate accurate claim evaluation and processing. Provide healthcare providers with medical justifications for rejected claims in line with international and Saudi medical guidelines. Negotiate and resolve disputed claims directly with healthcare providers when required. Achieve daily claims targets as assigned by the Claims Manager, approved by the Head of Medical. Collaborate with other departments to verify claim amounts, status, and related information. Support efficient, accurate, and compliant claims management through timely decision-making and communication. Qualifications and Experience Medicine Bachelor’s degree (MBBS). Licensed by the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS). 0-1 years of relevant experience. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, offering an opportunity to contribute to a structured claims management process within the insurance sector.

3d7576e230095e03.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اجال للمختبرات عن فني كيميائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في بريدة، القصيم. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ الأعمال الفنية والمخبرية المتعلقة بتحليل العينات، مع الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة المهنية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال وتجهيز وتحضير العينات لإجراء الفحوصات والتحاليل المخبرية. تنفيذ الاختبارات والتحاليل الكيميائية والمخبرية وفق الطرق والإجراءات المعتمدة. تشغيل الأجهزة والمعدات المخبرية والتأكد من جاهزيتها للاستخدام اليومي. تحضير المحاليل والكواشف والمواد اللازمة لإجراء الاختبارات بدقة. تسجيل وإدخال نتائج التحاليل في الأنظمة المعتمدة ومراجعة دقتها. تطبيق إجراءات ضبط ومراقبة الجودة على عمليات الفحص والتحليل. المحافظة على العينات وسلامة تخزينها والتعامل معها وفق الإجراءات المعتمدة. المحافظة على نظافة وترتيب المختبر والأجهزة والمعدات بشكل مستمر. الإبلاغ عن الأعطال والملاحظات الفنية المتعلقة بالأجهزة أو العينات. توثيق الأعمال والنتائج وإعداد التقارير المخبرية حسب متطلبات العمل. متطلبات الدور خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال فني كيميائي أو مخبري. القدرة على تنفيذ الأعمال الفنية والمخبرية المتعلقة باستقبال وتجهيز وتحليل العينات. الالتزام بمتطلبات الجودة والسلامة المهنية وإجراءات التعامل الآمن مع العينات والمواد الكيميائية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الكيمياء في بيئة مختبرية تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بالمعايير المهنية. يتطلب الدور التعامل مع الأجهزة والمعدات المخبرية والمواد الكيميائية، مما يستدعي الالتزام الصارم بإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية. الالتزام والمعايير يجب على شاغل الوظيفة الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات المختبر والمعايير المعتمدة في الجودة والسلامة، بما في ذلك إجراءات التعامل الآمن مع العينات والمواد الكيميائية. معلومات إضافية هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، والراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة بعد المقابلة.

3d819f95548910c2.job_title: Director of Sustainability Six Senses Southern Dunes The Red Sea
3d819f95548910c2.description: About the Role Riyad Bank is seeking a Corporate Social Responsibility Lead to develop and manage sustainable activities and programs. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, focuses on creating social and economic impact within the community and maintaining long-term relationships with local authorities to support welfare programs and sustainable growth. Key Responsibilities Adhere to all relevant departmental policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions to ensure consistent work execution. Manage day-to-day operations related to the role to ensure work continuity. Participate in developing Riyad Bank's Community Service strategy, plans, initiatives, and associated budget, ensuring alignment with marketing functions and overall bank objectives. Develop CSR publicity plans in cooperation with the Head of Community Service to maintain the bank's identity as a champion of community civic and economic advancement. Plan and execute economic development initiatives in communities where Riyad Bank operates through grants, community service, and voluntary programs to enhance the bank's image. Design and monitor programs aimed at improving the living standards of citizens and their families, including initiatives related to Hajj, youth development, subsidized education, donations, and sports, to promote Riyad Bank’s message. Monitor and assess CSR initiatives to ensure a positive impact across environmental, workplace, community, and cultural issues, thereby achieving agreed CSR targets. Contribute to identifying opportunities for continuous improvement in processes and practices, considering international best practices, business process enhancement, cost reduction, and productivity improvement. Assist in preparing timely and accurate reports for Riyad Bank to meet company and department requirements, policies, and standards. Comply with all relevant safety, quality, and environmental management policies, procedures, and controls to ensure a healthy and safe work environment. Perform other related duties or assignments as directed. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in corporate social responsibility or community development. The position requires a professional who can effectively manage and implement sustainable programs with a focus on social and economic impact. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within Riyad Bank. The role involves working collaboratively with various internal departments and external local authorities to achieve community service objectives.

3da4a85508d00115.description: About the Role ASBIS Middle East is seeking a Key Account Manager for Value Added Distribution (VAD) to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves generating demand, developing strategic customer relationships, and driving sales of VAD solutions to enterprise clients and system integrators across KSA. The position requires strong consultative selling skills and expertise in positioning value-added technologies to meet customer business and technical requirements. Key Responsibilities Promote and sell the ASBIS Value Added Distribution portfolio to system integrators and enterprise customers. Develop and manage relationships with key decision-makers, IT managers, procurement teams, and business stakeholders. Identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities within targeted enterprise accounts and verticals. Manage the complete sales cycle from prospecting and opportunity identification through proposal submission, negotiation, and deal closure. Understand customer business and technical requirements and position appropriate solutions from the VAD portfolio. Collaborate with presales, technical consultants, and vendor teams to design and present value-driven solutions. Prepare and deliver customer presentations, proposals, and business reviews. Maintain strong relationships with vendors and technology partners to maximize business opportunities and ensure accurate solution positioning. Drive revenue growth and market share expansion within assigned accounts and territories. Develop and maintain a healthy sales pipeline and provide accurate sales forecasts. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer requirements to identify growth opportunities. Ensure timely collection of receivables by monitoring customer payment status, following up on outstanding balances, and coordinating with Finance and Credit teams. Coordinate with Logistics, Operations, Product, and Finance teams to ensure smooth order processing and high levels of customer satisfaction. Represent ASBIS and vendor partners during customer meetings, industry events, training sessions, and business reviews. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Marketing, or a related field. 4+ years of experience in enterprise IT sales, value-added distribution, business development, or key account management. Proven track record of successfully selling enterprise technologies, including infrastructure, cybersecurity, networking, data center, software, or digital transformation solutions. Established network and strong relationships within the Saudi Arabian enterprise and system integrator ecosystem. Required Skills Strong consultative sales approach with the ability to identify customer needs and deliver business-driven solutions. Demonstrated success in achieving and exceeding revenue, gross profit, and business growth targets. Strong understanding of enterprise sales cycles, account planning, opportunity management, and partner engagement strategies. Commercially minded with solid knowledge of pricing strategies, profitability management, and market dynamics. Ability to engage effectively with both business and technical stakeholders at all organizational levels. Excellent negotiation, communication, presentation, and relationship management skills. Strong analytical, forecasting, and pipeline management capabilities. Ability to manage multiple strategic accounts, priorities, and opportunities in a fast-paced environment. Self-motivated, results-driven, and customer-focused professional with a proactive approach to business development. Work Environment and Benefits This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires willingness to travel within the country as needed. ASBIS Middle East offers the opportunity to work for a financially strong, fast-growing multinational company with constant interaction with global teams of professionals. Benefits include international career opportunities, access to continuous professional development through training and certification programs, a competitive salary package, and a motivation scheme. Application Process Candidates interested in this Key Account Manager position are encouraged to apply. The salary for this role will be disclosed during the interview process.

3d0c54e8d1d8d3af.company_name: King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Centre
3d0c54e8d1d8d3af.description: About the Role King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Center (KFSH) in Riyadh is seeking a Clinical Engineer I, specializing in Analytical, Imaging & Instrumentation. This full-time role involves providing essential operational and technical support for a wide range of medical, diagnostic, therapeutic, and analytical devices and systems used in patient healthcare and research. The successful candidate will serve as a designated technical specialist for assigned medical and research technology, ensuring its optimal performance and compliance with standards. Key Responsibilities Perform technical support duties for assigned medical and research technology. Provide scheduled preventive maintenance for assigned medical equipment, adhering to manufacturer’s guidelines. Execute medical and research technology operational support duties, including pre-acquisition analysis, site preparation, implementation, ongoing support analysis, and technology retirement. Train and guide Medical, Nursing, Clinical Engineer II’s, Clinical Engineering Technicians, SCDP participants, Student Interns, and other Clinical Engineering staff on the technical support of complex medical and research technology through informal on-the-job or formal classroom training. Act as a technical knowledge source for assigned medical and research technology. Ensure medical and research equipment meets all technical support requirements by vendors and complies with relevant KFSHRC standards prior to purchase. Provide and/or coordinate medical equipment user education and instruction. Maintain competency in the Clinical Engineering medical technology database and other related computer software programs. Participate in Hospital committees as assigned. Adhere to all Hospital policies and procedures. Participate in self and others' education, training, and development. Perform other related duties as assigned. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in clinical engineering or a related field. The role requires a strong technical background in supporting medical, diagnostic, therapeutic, and analytical devices and systems. Required Skills Proficiency in technical support and maintenance of medical and research technology. Ability to follow manufacturer's guidelines for repair and preventive maintenance. Strong analytical skills for pre-acquisition analysis and ongoing operational support. Competence in training and guiding staff on complex medical technology. Familiarity with medical technology databases and related software. Excellent communication and instructional skills for user education. Work Environment This position is based at King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Center in Riyadh. The role involves working within a dynamic healthcare and research environment, collaborating with various medical and technical teams to ensure the reliable operation of critical equipment. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time position. Salary details will be disclosed during the application process.

3d46d7840df735f0.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ألفال المميز للمقاولات عن محاسب تكاليف للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تخطيط ودراسة وتحليل عناصر حسابات التكلفة، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بمحاسبة التكاليف وحفظها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تخطيط ودراسة الأساليب المستخدمة في حساب التكلفة وتحديد عناصر التكلفة المباشرة وغير المباشرة. تحليل عناصر التكلفة المباشرة وغير المباشرة بشكل دوري، وتحديد معدل التكلفة المعيارية، وتحديد الانحرافات ومساهمة كل منها في زيادة أو تقليل التكلفة. إعداد التقارير الدورية المتعلقة بالتكاليف وطرق التسعير، وتقديم التوصيات للإدارة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات حساب التكاليف ومواكبة التطورات العلمية والتقنية في مجال المحاسبة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بحساب التكاليف، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال محاسبة التكاليف أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تخطيط ودراسة وتحليل عناصر حسابات التكلفة. مهارات قوية في إعداد التقارير والوثائق المالية وحفظها. موقع العمل ونوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل داعمة تساهم في تطوير المهارات المهنية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

3d593b43f4bffddb.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة أفراس للتجارة والمقاولات عن حاجتها لتوظيف إطفائي في مدينة الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إدارة وتشغيل محطة الإطفاء، والإشراف على فرق الإطفاء والإنقاذ، لضمان الجاهزية التامة للاستجابة السريعة والفعالة لحالات الطوارئ والحرائق وعمليات الإنقاذ، مع الالتزام بمعايير وإجراءات السلامة والإطفاء المعتمدة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية قيادة فرق الإطفاء والإنقاذ بالمحطة والإشراف عليها. إدارة عمليات الاستجابة للحرائق والحوادث وحالات الطوارئ. توزيع المهام على الفرق ومتابعة جاهزية الورديات. التأكد من جاهزية مركبات ومعدات وأنظمة الإطفاء والإنقاذ. التنسيق مع الجهات وخدمات الطوارئ ذات العلاقة أثناء الحوادث. الإشراف على التدريبات والتمارين وخطط الاستجابة للطوارئ. متابعة أعمال الفحص والصيانة الدورية لمعدات ومركبات الإطفاء. إعداد تقارير الحوادث والعمليات والجاهزية. التأكد من الالتزام بإجراءات السلامة ومعايير NFPA ومتطلبات العمل المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال الإطفاء والإنقاذ. معرفة قوية بمعايير وإجراءات السلامة والإطفاء. القدرة على قيادة الفرق وإدارة العمليات في حالات الطوارئ. نوع العمل وموقعه هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. التقديم للوظيفة للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة أفراس للتجارة والمقاولات، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم.

3d675b1dac611229.description: As the Senior Manager – Culture Strategy at Qiddiya Investment Company, you will lead the development of portfolio, asset, and project strategies across the Culture portfolio. Working across a diverse range of cultural assets and initiatives, you will drive strategic analysis, financial modeling, market research, and portfolio planning to support decision-making and long-term value creation. The role requires a proactive and commercially minded strategist who can independently deliver high-quality outcomes while supporting the development of team capabilities. 3d7b7ebe3387433e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة الهنوف الرائدة للادوات ومواد السلامة عن مساعد حسابات للانضمام إلى فريقها في خميس مشيط، عسير. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى دعم العمليات المحاسبية والمالية للمؤسسة، مع التركيز على دقة السجلات وإعداد التقارير. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مسك السجلات والدفاتر الخاصة بالعمليات والمبادلات المالية للمؤسسة. التحقق من دقة المستندات والسجلات المتعلقة بالمدفوعات والمقبوضات والمبادلات المالية الأخرى. إجراء الحسابات التقديرية اللازمة وتقييد ومراجعة القيود المحاسبية. تجميع وترصيد الحسابات في دفاتر الأستاذ بشكل منتظم. تجميع وتصنيف التقارير البيانية خلال فترات محددة لإظهار المدفوعات والمقبوضات وموازنة الحسابات الدائنة والمدينة. إعداد البيانات والحسابات المالية لعام أو فترة زمنية محددة. إعداد كشوف حسابات العملاء. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على مسك السجلات المحاسبية والمالية بدقة. فهم جيد للمبادئ المحاسبية الأساسية. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في التعامل مع البيانات المالية. مهارات تنظيمية جيدة لإدارة السجلات والتقارير. القدرة على إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل بوضوح. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة خميس مشيط، بمنطقة عسير، ضمن فريق عمل مؤسسة الهنوف الرائدة للادوات ومواد السلامة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

3d724f35c57835e5.description: About Lucid Motors Middle East Lucid Motors is dedicated to creating advanced mobility experiences through innovation, leveraging proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture. The company's approach emphasizes a commitment to excellence, integrating design, engineering, and production in-house across global facilities. Lucid aims to redefine automotive segments by combining range, performance, design, and space in its vehicles. Job Summary: Sr. Maintenance Technician Automation The Sr. Maintenance Technician Automation is responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and improving Body in White (BIW) automated manufacturing equipment. This full-time role ensures safe, reliable, and efficient production operations through preventive and corrective maintenance, advanced troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives. The position requires 2-5 years of experience and is based in King Abdullah Economic City, Makkah. Key Responsibilities Lead advanced troubleshooting and maintenance of automated manufacturing systems, including robots, conveyors, pneumatic systems, and BIW process equipment. Serve as the technical escalation point for complex automation, controls, robotics, and system integration issues. Perform hands-on diagnostics, maintenance, and technical support for PLC-based control systems, including hardware and software troubleshooting, fault analysis, and system recovery. Execute PLC programming, logic modifications, backups, and online monitoring. Configure, troubleshoot, and maintain VFDs and motor control systems. Understand and troubleshoot industrial network architecture, including diagnostics, addressing, and network topology. Diagnose and resolve communication faults between PLCs, robots, weld controllers, drives, HMIs, safety devices, and field I/O. Perform PLC to Robot communication, including signal handshaking, fault feedback, and cycle control, and implement PLC and Robot interfaces. Perform PLC to weld controller integration, including weld enable signals, fault feedback, process feedback, and alarms. Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot robots and integrated robotic cells across Body in White, Paint, and Assembly areas. Demonstrate advanced knowledge of pneumatic systems, including cylinder and valve operation, applications, and rebuilding. Establish, schedule, execute, and document preventive maintenance (PM) activities, and work with maintenance planners to improve the CMMS system. Ensure effective spare parts inventory management and lead time control for automation equipment. Lead commissioning, startup, and integration of new or modified automation systems. Direct and coordinate contractors and vendors in a safe, efficient, and cost-effective manner. Train and coach team members in automation systems, PLC troubleshooting, robotics interfaces, and best maintenance practices. Support continuous improvement initiatives to increase equipment reliability, uptime, and production efficiency. Enforce and model strict compliance with safety rules and regulations, including LOTO and electrical safety standards. Communicate professionally and effectively with production, engineering, quality, and management teams. Qualifications and Requirements 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Strong expertise in automotive OEM equipment, PLCs, electrical systems, pneumatics, robotics, and BIW automation. Work Conditions This role frequently requires standing, stooping, walking, and lifting objects up to 50 pounds. The ability to wear fall hazard PPE and enter confined spaces with appropriate training is also required. Compensation and Benefits Lucid offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays; paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours of paid time off, while salaried/exempt employees accrue up to 160 hours. Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program, with awards determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results.

3d87b822559598c0.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مدارس الخندق الأهلية عن معلم مرحلة متوسطة تربية إسلامية للانضمام إلى فريقها التعليمي في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تدريس طلاب المرحلة المتوسطة في مجال الدراسات الإسلامية، وتطوير خطط الدروس، وتقديم الدعم التعليمي الفردي والجماعي للطلاب. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع خطط الدروس بما يتوافق مع المنهج الدراسي والرؤية الأكاديمية للمدرسة، واختيار المصادر التعليمية، وتصميم المواد التعليمية والدروس. تدريس الطلاب في مجال الدراسات الإسلامية، وتقديم الدروس الفردية والجماعية، وتيسير المناقشات، وتحديد الواجبات. تنظيم الرحلات والأنشطة العملية ذات الصلة بالمناهج، وإدارة سلوك الطلاب وتفاعلاتهم داخل الفصل وخارجه. تحديد أهداف تعلم واضحة، وإعداد الاختبارات والواجبات وإدارتها، ووضع الدرجات لتقييم التقدم الأكاديمي للطلاب. تقديم المشورة للطلاب وأولياء أمورهم لتحسين الأداء والسلوك، وتحديد الطلاب الذين يحتاجون إلى دعم إضافي وتحديد الطرق المناسبة لتلبية احتياجاتهم. تسجيل الحضور والدرجات وأداء الطلاب بشكل فردي وإعداد التقارير اللازمة بذلك. حضور اجتماعات الموظفين والتنسيق الفعال مع الزملاء المدرسين والمسؤولين ومساعدي المدرسين. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال التدريس أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تدريس الدراسات الإسلامية للمرحلة المتوسطة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن شركة مدارس الخندق الأهلية في المدينة المنورة.

3db70188a01a93e8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة درة التعمير للتشغيل والصيانة عن مراقب خدمات عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في سكاكا، الجوف. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على أعمال وأنشطة موظفي الخدمات العامة، وتطوير إجراءات العمل، ومعالجة المشكلات التشغيلية لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة وتنسيق أعمال وأنشطة موظفي الخدمات العامة، وتحديد مهامهم وواجباتهم بناءً على حجم العمل والأولويات وقدرات العاملين. إعداد وتطوير برامج وإجراءات العمل، وتنسيق الأنشطة مع الوحدات التنظيمية الأخرى ذات الصلة لضمان التكامل. دراسة مشكلات العمل، وتحديد أسبابها، واقتراح بدائل الحلول الممكنة، واختيار الحل الأنسب، ثم متابعة التنفيذ والتقييم. تقييم أداء موظفي الخدمات العامة ومدى التزامهم باللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بمجال العمل. تحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية الفردية للموظفين وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة بالخدمات العامة أو الإشراف. القدرة على مراجعة وتنسيق الأنشطة وتحديد المهام بفعالية. مهارات في إعداد وتطوير برامج وإجراءات العمل. القدرة على تحليل المشكلات واقتراح الحلول المناسبة. مهارات تقييم الأداء وتحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية. بيئة العمل يعمل مراقب الخدمات العامة في بيئة عمل ديناميكية ضمن شركة درة التعمير للتشغيل والصيانة في مدينة سكاكا بمنطقة الجوف. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التزاماً بالإشراف المباشر وتنسيق الأنشطة اليومية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة في شركة درة التعمير للتشغيل والصيانة.

3dbebf69f3a75000.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع عيادات رياده عن فني مختبر طبي للانضمام إلى فريقه في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إجراء الفحوصات المخبرية بدقة، وصيانة المعدات، وتقديم النتائج لدعم التشخيص الطبي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تفقد وتشغيل وصيانة معدات حفظ وفحص العينات، وضبطها وفقاً لمتطلبات كل فحص. دراسة طلبات الأطباء لتحديد الفحوصات المطلوبة، وسحب عينات الدم، واستلام عينات البول والبراز. تدوين بيانات المرضى على العينات وحفظها وفقاً للمعايير الصحيحة. تحضير العينات للفحص والزراعة، واختيار مواد الفحص بالكميات والمواصفات المطلوبة. إجراء الفحوصات المختلفة والتحاليل الكيميائية والفيزيائية والمجهرية على العينات. استخراج النتائج وتوثيقها، وتقديمها للاختصاصي المشرف. إتلاف العينات المخبرية بعد الانتهاء من الفحوصات وتوثيق إجراءات الإتلاف. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المختبرات الطبية. القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل. بيئة العمل يعمل فني المختبر الطبي ضمن فريق مجمع عيادات رياده في جدة، مكة المكرمة، في بيئة عمل داعمة تركز على تقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال المقابلة.

3dea6cba83dad3e9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سمامة للتشغيل والإدارة عن فني هندسة إلكترونية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وصيانة الأنظمة والمعدات الإلكترونية، بالإضافة إلى دعم مهندسي الإلكترونيات في أنشطة البحث والتطوير. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب ومراقبة الأنظمة والمعدات الإلكترونية، بما في ذلك الدوائر وعناصر التحكم والآلات. تحديد المخططات ونوع وكمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الهندسية. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والميكانيكيين وغيرهم من الحرفيين أثناء عمليات تركيب الأنظمة الإلكترونية. اختبار الأنظمة بعد تركيبها لضمان التقيد بالمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. إجراء عمليات الفحص الروتينية للصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص التلفيات والأعطال المحتملة، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. تقديم المساعدة التقنية لمهندسي الإلكترونيات في جهود البحث والتطوير المتعلقة بالمعدات الإلكترونية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. فهم قوي لمبادئ الأنظمة الإلكترونية والمعدات. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والمواصفات الفنية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الهندسة الإلكترونية في بيئة ديناميكية في مدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في دعم العمليات التشغيلية والإدارية للشركة. معلومات إضافية هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وسيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة سمامة للتشغيل والإدارة، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر المنصة المخصصة.

3dff9c7af441cbef.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أفراس للتجارة والمقاولات عن مدرب مهني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، وتحديداً في الزلفي. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد وتنفيذ خطط التدريس والتدريب العملي في مجال التخصص، مع متابعة تجهيز وتشغيل ورش ومعامل التدريب. يتضمن الدور تقييم أداء الطلاب وتحصيلهم، وإعداد التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بتقدمهم. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل مناهج علوم المهنة والتدريب المهني في حقل الاختصاص وتحديد الأهداف التعليمية المباشرة. إعداد قوائم مستلزمات معامل أو ورش التدريب، وتحديد كمياتها ومواصفاتها، وتركيب تجهيزات المشاغل وتشغيلها. إعداد خطط تدريس المادة النظرية، وتصميم واختيار واستخدام التقنيات التربوية وطرق وأساليب التدريس الفعالة. تنفيذ وإدارة الدروس النظرية، وتصميم الاختبارات النظرية، وقياس تحصيل الطلاب. إعداد خطط الدروس والتطبيقات العملية وتنفيذها وإدارتها، وتنظيم التطبيقات العملية والميدانية للطلاب. تصميم الاختبارات العملية وقياس أداء الطلاب. تطوير أساليب التدريس وأدوات القياس والتقويم، ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في مجال الاختصاص. إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بأداء الطلاب وتحصيلهم الدراسي وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التدريب المهني أو التعليم الفني. القدرة على إعداد خطط تدريس نظرية وعملية متكاملة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتدريس الفعال. القدرة على تقييم أداء الطلاب وتقديم التغذية الراجعة البناءة. بيئة العمل يعمل المدرب المهني ضمن بيئة تعليمية وعملية داعمة في الزلفي، الرياض. تتطلب الوظيفة التفاعل المستمر مع الطلاب والإدارة لضمان تقديم أفضل مستويات التدريب. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويوفر فرصة للمساهمة في تطوير الكفاءات المهنية للطلاب. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

3d06e97cbb3c1428.description: About the Role HUDSON is seeking a Sales Team Leader – Air Compressor to join their team in the Eastern Province, specifically covering Dammam and Al Jubail. This is a full-time position focused on leading sales efforts for air compressors within an industrial B2B environment. Role Overview The Sales Team Leader will be responsible for driving sales of air compressors, managing customer relationships, and developing new business opportunities. The role requires a strong background in industrial sales and a deep understanding of air compressor products and the market. Key Responsibilities Lead sales activities for air compressors. Develop and maintain strong B2B customer relationships. Identify and pursue new business opportunities within the industrial sector. Negotiate sales agreements and close deals effectively. Manage sales processes from lead generation to post-sales support. Qualifications and Requirements Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in Air Compressor Sales. Mandatory experience in air compressor sales. Demonstrated experience with reputed compressor manufacturers such as Atlas Copco, Ingersoll Rand, Kaeser, ELGi, Gardner Denver, Sullair, Chicago Pneumatic, or similar companies is preferred. Proven track record in B2B sales and business development. Experience handling industrial customers. Required Skills Strong negotiation skills. Excellent customer relationship management abilities. Proficiency in identifying and developing new business opportunities. Compensation The basic salary offered for this position is SAR 7,000–8,000.

3d21e81101d01d0a.description: About the Role Dussmann-Ajlan & Bros is seeking a Project Director to join their team in Umluj, Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading the delivery of facilities management consultancy projects, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, client expectations, and applicable standards. The Project Director will act as a trusted advisor to clients, oversee FM service provider performance, lead multidisciplinary consultancy teams, and drive operational improvement, asset performance, and financial results. Key Responsibilities Direct FM consultancy projects, ensuring services meet agreed scope, quality standards, budgets, and delivery timelines. Develop project delivery plans, allocate resources, assign responsibilities, and monitor progress against milestones. Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, safety requirements, and relevant standards including SFG20, NFPA, SBC, ASHRAE, CIBSE, and BICSc. Serve as the primary senior point of contact for clients, FM service providers, and internal stakeholders, building strong client relationships. Oversee FM service providers, ensuring compliance with contractual requirements, service level agreements, and key performance indicators. Lead asset condition surveys and assessments, overseeing the preparation of asset replacement plans and associated tender documents. Lead the preparation of requests for proposals (RFPs), scopes of work, service specifications, and evaluation criteria. Lead and mentor multidisciplinary FM consultancy teams, setting clear objectives and accountability. Manage the profit and loss (P&L) performance of assigned FMC projects and contribute to company financial objectives. Required Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 15 years of relevant experience in facilities management, consultancy, or related operations. At least 5 years of experience in client-side FM consultancy or managing agent roles. Proven experience managing large-scale, high-profile, or VVIP facilities within government or corporate environments. Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary teams and overseeing FM service providers. Strong experience in asset condition assessments, FM tendering, mobilization, performance management, and technical advisory services. Proven capability in project budgeting, cost control, and P&L management. Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Facilities Management, or a related discipline. Certified Facility Manager (CFM) or Facility Management Professional (FMP). Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2. LEED Accredited Professional (LEED AP) or Certified Energy Manager (CEM). Relevant BICSc qualifications. NEBOSH International General Certificate or relevant OSHA training. Master of Business Administration (MBA) is an advantage. Key Competencies Strategic leadership and sound commercial judgment. Strong technical knowledge of hard and soft FM services. Client relationship management and stakeholder engagement. Contract management and service provider performance oversight. Analytical thinking, problem-solving, and risk management. Clear communication, report writing, and presentation skills. Team leadership, coaching, and continuous improvement. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Umluj, Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. The role requires a commitment to leading complex projects within a dynamic environment.

3d297cd03d3c9e4f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث بيت الخبرة الأولى عن محلل بيانات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على جمع البيانات ومعالجتها وتقديمها بصيغ متنوعة، بالإضافة إلى تطوير عمليات تحليل بيانات جديدة وتقديم المشورة بشأن معالجة البيانات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع قواعد البيانات ومراجعتها وتنظيفها وإدارتها، والتعاون مع مهندسي المنتجات والباحثين والأخصائيين لتحديد المشكلات ذات الصلة. تطوير الخوارزميات والنماذج الإحصائية، وإجراء التحليل الإحصائي المناسب، وتفسير النتائج. إعداد التقارير والمخططات والرسوم البيانية لمشاركة النتائج والتحليلات، وتوظيفها في صنع القرار. تحليل عمليات معالجة البيانات وجمعها في المنشأة، وتحديد فرص التحسين وتقديم المشورة حول مسار عمل موظفي الأبحاث. الحفاظ على الخبرة الفنية وتحديث المعارف بشكل مستمر، ودراسة المنشورات المتخصصة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال تحليل البيانات. القدرة على جمع البيانات ومعالجتها وتقديمها بصيغ وتنسيقات متنوعة. مهارات قوية في تطوير عمليات جديدة لتحليل البيانات. القدرة على تقديم المشورة بخصوص عمليات معالجة البيانات. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تحليلية قوية والقدرة على تفسير البيانات المعقدة. القدرة على تطوير الخوارزميات والنماذج الإحصائية. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والعروض التقديمية. التعاون الفعال مع الفرق المتعددة التخصصات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في تحسين عمليات تحليل البيانات وصنع القرار. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

3d418c5267d2cedf.description: About the Role Norconsult Telematics is seeking a Senior Business Excellence Lead to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on establishing and implementing an Infrastructure Quality Assurance Framework to ensure the quality, compliance, and performance of the Infrastructure Asset Development & Delivery lifecycle. Role Objectives The primary objective of this position is to monitor adherence to approved standards, policies, and procedures, measure operational performance through KPIs and executive dashboards, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. The aim is to enhance operational excellence, process maturity, and overall business outcomes within the infrastructure sector. Key Responsibilities Establish and implement an Infrastructure Quality Assurance framework to assess sector effectiveness, consistency, and compliance across the asset development and delivery lifecycle. Monitor the quality and compliance of the Infrastructure Asset Development & Delivery project cycle, ensuring adherence to approved policies, standards, procedures, and governance requirements. Develop, maintain, and automate executive dashboards to monitor process performance, quality, compliance, KPIs, SLAs, risks, and improvement initiatives. Define and monitor quality KPIs and process performance metrics to measure operational efficiency, process maturity, customer satisfaction, and service delivery excellence. Conduct regular infrastructure sector quality reviews and compliance assessments to identify process deviations, control weaknesses, non-conformities, and improvement opportunities. Perform trend analysis and root cause analysis on quality issues, process failures, recurring defects, and compliance gaps, recommending corrective and preventive actions. Monitor adherence to key Infrastructure delivery milestones, including Scope of Work, Work Orders, MOP, As-Built, PAT, Handover, Asset Capitalization, and Asset Registration, ensuring compliance with defined quality standards. Participate in process governance and quality review meetings, presenting KPI dashboards, compliance status, quality trends, risks, and recommendations to management. Coordinate internal quality assessments, audits, and governance reviews, ensuring timely closure of audit findings and implementation of corrective actions. Support the implementation of the EFQM Excellence Model by monitoring business excellence indicators, conducting maturity assessments, and tracking organizational improvement initiatives. Collaborate with Process Owners and Infrastructure stakeholders to improve process quality, strengthen governance, and drive operational excellence across Infrastructure functions. Ensure process documentation, standards, procedures, and controls remain current and accurately reflect operational practices and governance requirements. Identify opportunities for continuous improvement by leveraging operational data, quality metrics, benchmarking, and industry best practices to enhance efficiency and customer value. Prepare executive reports and management presentations summarizing process quality, compliance, performance trends, risks, and strategic recommendations. Promote a culture of quality, governance, compliance, and continuous improvement by providing guidance, coaching, and awareness sessions across Infrastructure teams. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience is required for this role. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within Norconsult Telematics. The role involves working collaboratively with various stakeholders and teams to achieve business excellence objectives.

3d745c338d6f3ff2.description: About the Tamheer Physiotherapist Program Dr. Sulaiman Al Habib (HMG) is seeking motivated candidates to join its team through the Tamheer Program as a Physiotherapist. This internship offers the opportunity to gain practical experience within a professional work environment. The program is designed for individuals looking to develop their skills and contribute to a healthcare setting. Program Overview The Tamheer Program provides participants with hands-on experience in physiotherapy. Interns will work alongside experienced professionals, applying theoretical knowledge in a clinical setting. The program aims to equip participants with the practical skills necessary for a career in physiotherapy. Benefits of Participation Receive a monthly financial allowance through the Tamheer program. Gain direct practical experience in a professional healthcare environment. Obtain a certificate upon successful completion of the program. Qualifications and Requirements Fresh graduate or not previously registered in GOSI. Eligible for the Tamheer Program. Holds a Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field. Demonstrates willingness and commitment to complete the entire training program. Work Environment Participants will be integrated into a professional work environment at Dr. Sulaiman Al Habib (HMG), providing exposure to real-world healthcare operations and patient care protocols. This internship is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements and are interested in gaining practical experience in physiotherapy are encouraged to apply for this Tamheer Program opportunity.

3db713e043f2b69c.description: About the Role The Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority in Riyadh is seeking a Vendors Management & LC Specialist for a full-time position. This role is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience, focusing on specific tasks under close supervision. The specialist will contribute to research, information gathering, analysis, and report drafting, while also developing professional expertise within the organization. Key Responsibilities Understand and apply local content regulations from the Local Content and Government Procurement Authority. Assess local markets in targeted areas to identify purchasing opportunities for materials, equipment, spare parts, and innovation. Consolidate assessment results, including market overviews, challenges, analysis, and supplier lists, to classify materials for internal or external procurement. Evaluate suppliers post-pre-qualification according to established guidelines and present findings to stakeholders. Coordinate with the Procurement Planning and Supplier Qualification Department for qualification assessments and to update the qualified supplier database. Classify qualified suppliers based on procurement needs and prepare categorized lists for reference during the terms of reference/request for quotation process. Continuously review supplier evaluation reports, update the supplier blacklist, and maintain the supplier qualification database. Receive purchase requests, verify budget validity, and identify sourcing categories. Direct approved purchase requests to the appropriate purchasing approach. Prepare terms of reference/requests for quotations, detailing timelines, templates, guiding principles, and expected price ranges. Gather information on the technical scope for terms of reference or requests for quotation, drafting proposals with all required technical and administrative details. Develop technical and financial evaluation dimensions and frameworks in coordination with relevant parties. Verify the qualification database, evaluate potential suppliers, and shortlist them for competition packages. Send requests for information and respond to questions promptly. Verify technical and commercial offers for local content requirements. Receive, evaluate, and verify delivered goods against terms and conditions, addressing any deficiencies or non-compliance. Monitor transactions between suppliers and requesting departments to ensure goods receipt and verify documents/invoices for payment processing. Adhere to all relevant policies, processes, and standard operating procedures. Assist in resolving escalated issues and provide support to less experienced team members. Escalate complex issues to ensure appropriate resolution. Perform other business-related tasks as required. Professional Development and Support Train less experienced employees on functional activities to facilitate knowledge transfer. Provide clear directions, prioritize tasks, assign responsibilities, and monitor the workflow of subordinates or less experienced employees. Support less experienced employees or direct subordinates in task execution according to specified policies and processes. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of relevant experience. Ability to perform specific tasks individually under close supervision. Proficiency in research, information gathering, and analysis. Experience in drafting reports and documents. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, offering an environment focused on professional growth and adherence to established operational procedures within the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority.

3d698f813df9d858.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة طرق الجزيرة للمباني والطرق عن فني مساحة للانضمام إلى فريقها في أحد المسارحة، جازان. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ أعمال المساحة المتنوعة للمشاريع الإنشائية، بما في ذلك المسح الاستطلاعي والتسوية ورسم الخرائط والمخططات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ أعمال المساحة الاستكشافية للمشاريع الإنشائية المختلفة وإعداد مسودات للمنشآت والعوائق والقنوات والطرق الفرعية. تحديد وتثبيت نقاط الاستناد الرئيسة والفرعية ونقاط الربط، واختيار الأجهزة والأدوات المساحية المناسبة. تنفيذ أعمال التسوية الطولية والعرضية لشبكات البنية التحتية المتنوعة. إجراء أعمال التسوية الشبكية لمشاريع الأبنية والأراضي. تثبيت مواقع وحدود الأبنية على الأرض بناءً على المخططات. نقل وتثبيت مواقع وحدود الأبنية القائمة على المخططات، وتثبيت مناسيب جميع الأعمال المتعلقة بالمشروع. تثبيت مسارات الطرق وسكك الحديد وتقاطعاتها، وتوقيع المنحنيات المختلفة وفقاً للمخططات. رسم المقاطع العرضية والطولية والمنحنيات الأفقية والرأسية والمخططات الكنتورية والمساحية المستخدمة في أعمال المساحة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المساحة أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تنفيذ أعمال المساحة الاستطلاعية والتسوية المساحية. مهارات في رسم الخرائط والمخططات المساحية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في أحد المسارحة، جازان. سيعمل فني المساحة ضمن فريق متخصص في مشاريع الأبنية والطرق. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة.

3dc46a5d4248110d.description: The Auto Painter is responsible for preparing and painting vehicle surfaces to restore vehicles to their original appearance and manufacturer standards. The role requires accurate color matching, proper surface preparation, paint application, and finishing while maintaining high standards of quality, safety, and productivity. Inspect vehicle body surfaces and identify areas requiring painting or refinishing. Prepare surfaces by cleaning, sanding, masking, filling, and applying primer as required. Mix and prepare paints, primers, clear coats, and other refinishing materials according to manufacturer specifications. Perform accurate paint color matching using paint codes and color-matching systems. Apply basecoat, paint, and clear coat using spray guns and appropriate painting techniques. Ensure proper paint thickness, coverage, color consistency, and finish quality. Perform blending and spot repairs to achieve a seamless finish between repaired and existing panels. Polish and finish painted surfaces to achieve the required gloss and appearance. Inspect completed work and correct any defects such as runs, orange peel, dust, uneven coverage, or color mismatch. Follow repair orders and ensure work is completed according to the required specifications and timelines. Maintain and properly use spray guns, mixing equipment, sanding tools, and other workshop equipment. Maintain a clean and organized work area and ensure proper handling and storage of paint and chemicals. Follow all HSE, environmental, and workshop safety procedures, including the correct use of PPE. Minimize material wastage and use paint and consumables efficiently. Coordinate with Body Repair Technicians, Estimators, Parts, and Workshop Supervisors to ensure smooth repair operations. Complete assigned jobs within the required productivity and quality standards. Report any technical issues, additional repair requirements, or material shortages to the supervisor. Qualifications & Experience High school diploma, vocational certificate, or technical qualification in Automotive Body & Paint / Auto Refinishing. Minimum 2–5 years of experience as an Auto Painter in an automotive dealership, body shop, or collision repair center. Good knowledge of automotive paint systems, refinishing materials, and painting techniques. Experience with water-based and solvent-based paint systems is preferred. Experience with computerized color-matching systems is an advantage. Knowledge of vehicle body repair and refinishing processes. Ability to read and follow repair orders and technical instructions.

3dd7795a73debd60.description: Eram Talent is seeking a Drilling Foreman to join our Unconventional Resources Drilling Department (URDD). Candidate primary role will be to supervise field operations of land Drilling and Workover rigs, engaged in carrying programmed work on deep or otherwise critical wells. Supervises and oversees the operations of a contract rig performing drilling or remedial work on wells ranging from 18,000 - 23,000 feet. Incumbent will ensure that the contractor performs the work in a safe and acceptable manner, and that the contractor meets all the obligations of his contract. Coordinates deliveries of well materials and equipment and ensures it is available when the rig is ready for it. Drilling Rig Foreman administers the contracts on sight and serves as the primary liaison between the company and the contractor. Responsibilities Ensure all rig personnel and service providers are complaining with Saudi Aramco safety standards and requirement. Supervises and oversees all operations performed on wells. Makes recommendations on alternative methods or equipment when unusual situations are encountered. Coordinates deliveries of materials to the well to ensure it is available when required. Ensures that contractor meets all requirements of his contract. Works with Drilling and Workover engineers to see that modern drilling practices are followed. Approves contractor daily tour report. Ensures that contractor rig and equipment are properly maintained to avoid downtime. Performs other miscellaneous duties as directed by Supt. Ensures that Saudi Aramco Blowout Prevention Standards are met in all respects including equipment configuration, testing and crew response. Assures that rig and personnel comply with Saudi Aramco established safety standards and procedures. Minimum of 7 years of experience working in drilling and workover operations including adequate supervisory experience on a drilling or workover rig. Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field is preferred; Extensive knowledge of drilling equipment, techniques, and safety measures; Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills; Ability to work in high-pressure environments and make quick decisions; Willingness to work in remote locations and harsh weather conditions.

3d73dcbc4c489b4d.description: Müller's Solutions, a distinguished consulting firm specializing in Tech Outsourcing, Managed Services, SAP Implementation & Support, and Global Tech Recruitment, is seeking a skilled Business Analyst to join a significant team currently engaged in the development of an enterprise solution within the public sector. The selected candidate will collaborate with a team of experienced solution architects to enhance their knowledge and competencies in the designated domain. The Business Analyst will be responsible for gathering and documenting business requirements, mapping business processes, performing application testing, conducting end-user training, and troubleshooting issues related to existing applications. Responsibilities Demonstrates professionalism as a representative of AEC, successfully collaborating within a diverse work environment. Engages in cross-functional team meetings aimed at formulating and executing business solutions while enhancing operational efficiency. Performs impact assessments of ERP products and other applications, systems, upgrades, and modifications across functional areas, and evaluates both systems and business processes. Assists in the analysis and redesign of business processes pertaining to the assigned domain(s). Ensures a comprehensive understanding of necessary business functions and processes, documenting these accordingly. Documents requirements specifications for enhancements, upgrades, and remaining legacy functions in accordance with standard templates. Aids in the documentation of requirements and procedures. Coordinates with other application areas to address interdependencies and resolve issues. Oversees post-implementation reviews and monitors business applications within the assigned domain(s). Participates in the Change Request process to authorize, document, test, and validate all modifications to the ERP and other applications. Maintains the confidentiality of information at all times. Shares confidential information acquired during the course of employment only with authorized individuals and with prior approvals as required. Fosters and maintains effective and productive relationships with customers and other team members. EDUCATION: • A Graduate or Post Graduate Degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or an equivalent field from a reputable national or international educational institution. • Certification in either SAP or Oracle is considered an advantage. • Proficiency in both English and Arabic languages is required. RELEVANT EXPERIENCE: • A minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a similar role. • Proven experience in gathering and documenting system requirements as well as detailing system functional design for business application solutions, alongside addressing related implementation issues from a functional standpoint. • Familiarity with enterprise-wide system implementation, integration, interfaces, and data conversion. • Experience with Software Development Life Cycle methodologies. • Experience in the defense sector is considered a plus. SKILLS REQUIREMENTS: • Strong communication skills. • Ability to conduct training sessions. • Understanding and practical experience with technology as an enabler. • Demonstrated capability to work effectively within a diverse team. Why Join Us: Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team. Competitive salary and benefits package. Exciting projects and innovative work environment.
